主要内容: G2 Capital Advisors, a middle market investment banking & M&A advisory firm, has deployed Navatar's M&A Cloud and Navatar Deal Connect to manage their M&A business and build worldwide connections. Navatar's M&A CRM enables boutique M&A firms and investment banks to develop new business, find the right buyers/sellers, and manage the entire deal process. It allows them to operate from anywhere using laptops or mobile devices. Navatar M&A CRM is fully integrated with Navatar Deal Connect, the global online marketplace for collaborating on middle market transactions. The platform supports various aspects of M&A business, including prospect and buyer database management, marketing, business development, and deal execution. G2 Capital Advisors has a great reputation for client focus, and Navatar Group is proud to help them expand their business and network.
